questionText:
Read the following clinical nutrition and specialized feeding case study and answer the questions that follow:

Mr. Rajesh, a 45-year-old construction supervisor, is admitted to the Surgical Intensive Care Unit (SICU) with severe polytrauma, multiple rib fractures, and blunt abdominal injury following a building collapse. He undergoes emergency laparotomy and small bowel resection. During the immediate post-operative period (first 48 hours), paralytic ileus is present with absent bowel sounds, requiring temporary intravenous hydration. As hemodynamic stability is restored on Day 3, the clinical nutrition team evaluates the optimal nutritional support strategy:
1. The surgical fellow proposes keeping the patient on prolonged Total Parenteral Nutrition (TPN) through a central venous catheter.

questionText: [Set 40.42] In pediatric clinical assessment, Kwashiorkor is clinically distinguished from Marasmus by the prominent presence of:

options.text: Severe muscle wasting and subcutaneous fat depletion without oedema (skin and bone appearance)
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: Vitamin C scurvy bleeding gums exclusively
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: Oedema (fluid accumulation in legs and face) and enlarged fatty liver with adequate calorie intake but acute protein deficiency
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately solves the problem for Nutritional Deficiency: Kwashiorkor vs Marasmus.

options.text: Excessive subcutaneous adipose tissue and childhood obesity
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
For Nutritional Deficiency: Kwashiorkor vs Marasmus (Nutrition, Food Science and Technology):
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT Class 12 Home_Science (Public Nutrition and Health - Nutritional Deficiency: Kwashiorkor vs Marasmus):
Kwashiorkor is caused by acute protein deficiency despite sufficient caloric intake, leading to generalized oedema, enlarged fatty liver, lethargy, and a 'moon face'. Marasmus is total protein-energy malnutrition characterized by severe wasting without oedema.

Hence, Option (B) is the correct answer.

Therefore, option (C) is the correct answer.

For Pasteurization of Milk (HTST Method) (Nutrition, Food Science and Technology):

According to NCERT Class 12 Home_Science (Food Processing and Technology - Pasteurization of Milk (HTST Method)):

Hence, Option (B) is the correct answer.

topic: Styles of Food and Beverage Service
questionText:
Match the food service style in List I with its operational definition in List II:

List I:
(A) Plate Service (American Service)
(B) Silver Service (English Service)
(C) Buffet Service
(D) Gueridon Service

List II:
(I) Food is pre-portioned and plated in the kitchen, then served to the guest from the right side
(II) Food is presented on silver platters to the guest and served using service spoon and fork from the left side
(III) Dishes are arranged attractively on long food tables; guests move along the line to serve themselves
(IV) Food is prepared, carved, or flambéed table-side in front of the guest on a mobile cooking trolley

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.text: A-II, B-I, C-III, D-IV
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: A-I, B-II, C-III, D-IV
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Correctly maps each entity across columns.

options.text: A-IV, B-II, C-I, D-III
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: A-I, B-III, C-IV, D-II
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
American is pre-plated; Silver presents on platters from left; Buffet is self-service; Gueridon cooks/flambés table-side on trolleys.
Hence Option C is correct.
Hence, option (B) is the correct match.
